rounds.text: IFB Agro Industries Ltd carries significant underlying operational and structural weaknesses that undermine its current valuation. Long-term capital efficiency is notably poor, evidenced by a 10-year median return on equity of 8% and a depressed 3-year median ROE of just 4% [E26, E28]. This anemic return profile trails sector benchmarks substantially, with the company's ROE of 8.39% lagging far behind the 15.09% sector average [E9]. Growth consistency is equally problematic, as demonstrated by a 3-year compounded sales growth rate slowing to 4% and an inconsistent yearly operating-margin trend [E16, E32]. Furthermore, short-term financial stability faces pressure from a sudden surge in debt, with borrowings climbing sharply to Rs 71 Cr in Mar 2026 from just Rs 6 Cr a year prior [E39]. Conceded: the company demonstrates a strong recent trailing twelve-month sales growth of 33% alongside positive free cash flow of Rs 74 Cr in Mar 2026 [E17, E36].
